summary: Verification of PR 5284 at the merged head a225b9d4af9f295e3c84b7ff6f35ef7e71ababc1 (parents confirmed: 3d530d7639eeb0b4bd8ee11227a1133fe66aa672 and upstream main 82888694ae248b74d105d9c7b5f60d33c385f325; fork branch and live PR head re-verified equal before the run and at filing; PR still open and draft). Combined suites at seed 16398C0DE: RebalanceLeadersAPITest 6/6, MigrateDocsAPITest 10/10, MigrateRouteKeyTest 5/5, V2CollectionAPIMappingTest 2/2, TestCollectionAPIs 2/2, TestApiFramework 3/3, TestRebalanceLeaders 4 passed plus the @Nightly testRebalanceLeaders skipped as in prior rounds, V2ApiIntegrationTest 12/13. All eight mutations discriminated by assertion at this head: the two rebalance constructor-argument mutations failed testBodyParametersReachOperation with expected:<2> but was:<99> and expected:<30> but was:<999>; the six MigrateDocs omission mutations each failed testAllPropertiesAndAsyncId with the captured message missing exactly the omitted entry (collection, target.collection, split.key, forward.timeout=45, followAliases=true), and the async mutation failed with 'Wrong asyncId for command expected:<migrateAsyncId> but was:<null>'.
